acquisition.bodyInterpretation: Six official HTML content bodies and one captcha HTML response, two original PDFs recovered offline, one TLS EOF with a single application-form-only web fallback. TYUT image-only PDF was visually read in full. Captcha and HTTP 200 are not date proof.

rules: Source-only observations: no canonical dates, status, publication, verifiedAt or reviewAfter changed.
Unknown and blocked never establish availability; closed applies only to an explicitly bound past window.
Recurring rules, attachment filenames and separate CSCA dates are not rolled into target-year deadlines.
General applicant cutoffs are not institution review dates and are not borrowed by independent scholarships.
One reasonable failed-source fallback ends in cooldown. No captcha bypass or repeated original PDF GET.
The 2026 window is not a 2027 successor observation and does not prove programme cessation.
